article.title: Israeli strikes kill four and destroy hospital in south Lebanon
article.summary: Israeli strikes kill four and destroy hospital in south LebanonIsraeli strikes killed four people and destroyed a hospital in south Lebanon amid relentless bombing of the Nabatieh region, Lebanese media reported.The ministry reported that two people were killed in Nabatieh al-Fawqa and two women were killed in nearby Arab Salim. Twenty people were also wounded in several locations, including women and three children.In Nabatieh al-Fawqa, an Israeli strike levelled Ghandour Hospital, which had closed several years ago. It was the first time Israel had destroyed a hospital in Lebanon since 2023, according to L'Orient Today newspaper.Israel said Hezbollah launched two exploding drones towards its soldiers in the occupied "buffer zone".

article.title: Israeli strikes kill four in southern Lebanon

article.title: Israeli airstrikes on village in southern Lebanon kill 9 people, wound 13
article.summary: Kfar Rumman, Sep 07:Israel's air force carried out two strikes early Monday on a southern Lebanese village, killing at least nine people, including women and children, Lebanon's Health Ministry said.The ministry said one of the strikes hit a building, killing eight people, including a child and two women. It added that 11 people were also wounded, including four children and two women.The ministry added that another strike on a car in the village killed a paramedic with the Lebanese Islamic Risala Scout Association and wounded two others.The strikes came amid a new round of escalation between Israel and Hezbollah.

article.title: Lebanese president denounces Israeli attacks and destruction in south
article.summary: Lebanese president denounces Israeli attacks and destruction in southLebanese President Joseph Aoun has condemned what he described as Israel’s “repeated attacks”, including the killing of civilians and destruction of homes and property.Aoun said the attacks, which he said had killed “innocent civilians, including children and women”, were undermining efforts to prevent further escalation in southern Lebanon and across the region.Aoun said Lebanon supports renewing the mandate of the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (Unifil) and is working with French President Emmanuel Macron to facilitate the extension.“We also welcome the French and Italian initiative to form a European force to fill the void after Unifil’s withdrawal,” he added.Smoke rises from an explosion in Al-Mansouri, southern Lebanon, seen from al-Hanniyeh, 6 September 2026 (Kawnat Haju/AFP)

article.title: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanese town kill 11, state news agency says
article.summary: BEIRUT:Israeli strikeson a southern Lebanese town early on Monday killed at least 11 people including two children and two medics, Lebanon’s state news agency said.Israel has intensified its bombardment of south Lebanon in recent days despite a June ceasefire that was meant to halt fighting between the Israeli military and Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.At least seven people were killed in Israeli strikes on Sunday.
